additional_info.body:
Hi Rasmus,
This error is because of that "SyntaxError...."
I fixed your issue for the moment with a EcoG reboot. The best mitigation here is to set a auto reboot and if this error appears again a reboot will fix it.
If you face it again next time, please let me know because I found out that there are a set of logs that I need to collect in a very specific way and I was not aware. For this you can reach out to me via Teams since we don't know how long it will take to reoccur.
What is your opinion? Can I close the ticket and you reach out to me next time or should I send you the ticket and next time you reach out to me?
Thanks!
Best regards,
Francisco
